sources.title: Knowledge-driven drug repurposing using a comprehensive drug knowledge graph
sources.authors: Yongjun Zhu, Chao Che, Bo Jin, Ningrui Zhang, Chang Su, Fei Wang
sources.summary: Zhu and colleagues assemble a drug knowledge graph with treats, interacts, and side-effect links, then show that those paths can recover known diabetes treatments. That is the same graph pattern MMSS uses for type 2 diabetes medicines.

sources.title: Data-driven prediction of drug effects and interactions
sources.authors: Nicholas P. Tatonetti, Patrick P. Ye, Roxana Daneshjou, Russ B. Altman
sources.summary: Tatonetti and colleagues mine observational data to flag drug–drug interaction effects at population scale. That work underpins why this project checks type 2 diabetes medicines against interacting outpatient drugs.

sources.title: Cardiovascular diseases in India: current epidemiology and future directions
sources.authors: Dorairaj Prabhakaran, Panniyammakal Jeemon, Ambuj Roy
sources.summary: Prabhakaran and colleagues describe India’s cardiovascular burden and the central role of raised blood pressure. That epidemiology is why MMSS treats hypertension as a core outpatient disease rather than a generic drug list.

sources.title: Data-driven prediction of drug effects and interactions
sources.authors: Nicholas P. Tatonetti, Patrick P. Ye, Roxana Daneshjou, Russ B. Altman
sources.summary: This paper’s interaction-signal methods are the literature basis for checking blood-pressure medicines against interacting analgesics and other co-prescribed drugs.

sources.title: Clinical profile of rheumatoid arthritis patients reporting to a tertiary care center – data from southwestern part of India
sources.authors: A.V.S. Anil Kumar, Kapil Gupta, Shipra Kartik, Shruti Kumar
sources.journal: International Journal of Contemporary Medical Research
sources.summary: Kumar and colleagues report the clinical profile of rheumatoid arthritis in southwestern India and note methotrexate as the usual disease-modifying medicine. That matches the arthritis set used in this project.

sources.title: Data-driven prediction of drug effects and interactions
sources.authors: Nicholas P. Tatonetti, Patrick P. Ye, Roxana Daneshjou, Russ B. Altman
sources.summary: The Twosides-style interaction evidence in this paper is why arthritis medicines such as methotrexate and NSAIDs are checked as interacting pairs rather than reviewed in isolation.
